_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); railroad signals

pit_profile.why: Union Pacific: the largest railroad in North America, covering 23 states across the western two-thirds of the US, with BNSF its main rail competitor on parallel routes; carload volume follows the industrial economy, the franchise does not

classification.quality_note: Union Pacific: the largest railroad in North America, covering 23 states across the western two-thirds of the US, with BNSF its main rail competitor on parallel routes; carload volume follows the industrial economy, the franchise does not. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price rich; Ratio B 3.18x; +76% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap -0.98; conservative 2yr +2%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -7.7%/yr (worst year FY11-FY21, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +18.0%/yr (Q4 2021 revenue + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +18.0%/yr (FY11-FY21 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +24.9%/yr (best 2-yr run FY11-FY21); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: UNP (retrospective, 2022-01-28) ✕ AVOID — Ratio B 3.18x (49.2% downside to Bear $125 / +15.5% upside to Bull $284) | Adj composite 2.64 vs market 3.62: gap -0.98 [OVERVALUED] | +77% above the EPP floor $139 (14x FY22E $9.95) | Conservative 2-yr case: +2.0% total (+1.0%/yr) | At 24.7x FY22E the 15% hurdle price $325 sits above the BULL case; carloads -4% in Q4 2021, forward revenue +10% (no FY22 revenue guide, Q4 2021 freight revenue); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
